title: Discrete Flow Matching for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.12379v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many reinforcement learning (RL) tasks have discrete action spaces, but most generative policy methods based on diffusion and flow matching are designed for continuous control. Meanwhile, generative policies usually rely heavily on offline datasets and offline-to online RL is itself challenging, as the policy must improve from new interaction without losing useful behavior learned from static data. To address those challenges, we introduce DRIFT, an online fine-tuning method that updates an offline pretrained continuous time Markov chain (CTMC) policy with an advantage-weighted discrete flow matching loss. To preserve useful pretrained knowledge, we add a path-space penalty that regularizes the full CTMC trajectory distribution, rather than only the final action distribution. translated_title: 面向离线到在线强化学习的离散流匹配
translated_abstract: 许多强化学习（RL）任务具有离散动作空间，但大多数基于扩散模型和流匹配的生成式策略方法都是为连续控制设计的。同时，生成式策略通常严重依赖离线数据集，而离线到在线强化学习本身就充满挑战，因为策略必须在不丢失从静态数据中学到的有用行为的前提下，通过新的交互不断改进。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了DRIFT，这是一种在线微调方法，通过优势加权的离散流匹配损失来更新离线预训练的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）策略。为了保留有用的预训练知识，我们引入了一个路径空间惩罚项，对完整的CTMC轨迹分布进行正则化，而不仅仅约束最终的动作分布。对于大型离散动作空间，我们提出了一种候选集近似方法，在从参考策略中采样的少量动作子集上更新策略网络。
tldr: 提出DRIFT方法，利用优势加权的离散流匹配损失在线微调离线预训练的连续时间马尔可夫链策略，并通过路径空间正则化保留预训练知识，解决了离散动作空间下离线到在线强化学习的难题。
en_tdlr: DRIFT is an online fine-tuning method that adapts an offline pretrained CTMC policy via advantage-weighted discrete flow matching with a path-space regularizer, enabling effective offline-to-online RL for discrete action spaces.
